event_definition: First recorded Form 8-K or 8-K/A Item 1.03 filing in supplied SEC submissions histories, within (decision date, decision date + 60 calendar days]. Disclosure event, not verified bankruptcy onset or payment default. Negative windows require an issuer filing at or after the horizon; labels become usable after that confirmation and the complete horizon.
sample: All eligible local companyfacts issuers with complete referenced submissions histories, domestic periodic forms, and current SIC outside 6000-6999; no current ticker filter.

policy_scenario.gaps: start a new hypothetical assessment after a missing month
policy_scenario.reopening: no automatic reopening after zero within a continuous segment
policy_scenario.hard_stop: first Item 1.03 disclosure filed before decision date
policy_scenario.fallback: If no model passes the predeclared selection rule, report absence of validated improvement and use the constant training-prevalence benchmark for policy scenarios.
